follower_count.description: Required follower count for successful records.

verified.description: Whether Instagram marks the account as verified.

scraped_timestamp.description: UTC timestamp at which this record was scraped.

full_name.description: Display name. Omitted from the record when absent.

biography.description: Profile bio text, including intentionally empty strings.

bio_links.description: Public links listed on the Instagram profile.

following_count.description: Number of accounts this creator follows.

business_account.description: Whether Instagram marks the profile as business.

professional_account.description: Whether Instagram marks the profile as professional.

unpublished.description: Whether Instagram marks the account as unpublished.

memorialized.description: Whether Instagram marks the account as memorialized.

coppa_enforced.description: Whether Instagram marks COPPA enforcement on the account.

account_badges.description: Raw account badge objects exposed by Instagram.

linked_fb_info.description: Raw linked Facebook profile/page metadata, when exposed.

text_post_app_badge_label.description: Threads/text-post app badge label, when exposed.

show_text_post_app_badge.description: Whether clients should show the text-post app badge.

bio_link.description: A public link listed on an Instagram profile.

title.description: Display label shown for the link.

lynx_url.description: Instagram linkshim URL for the destination.

image_url.description: Optional image URL; may be an empty string.

media_type.description: Instagram media type for the link preview, e.g. none.

media_accent_color_hex.description: Optional accent color; may be an empty string.

creation_source.description: Instagram source that created the link metadata.

is_pinned.description: Whether the profile owner pinned the link.
